threads.title: The Glitch Meter
threads.description: Artie's class instability and the need for rare resources.

threads.title: The Guild Pursuit
threads.description: The local and global authorities hunting the anomaly.

sections.title: Office Space to Outer Space
sections.end_condition: Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard.

scenes.outcome: Artie's reality dissolves as the System initiates the isekai process.
scenes.transition_in_text: The hum of the office air conditioning is the only sound as Artie types his tenth report of the day.
scenes.transition_out_text: The text on the screen begins to bleed into the air, glowing with an eerie blue light.

scenes.outcome: Artie selects the 'Glitch-Crit' class despite the System's warnings.
scenes.transition_in_text: The white light fades, leaving Artie suspended in a pitch-black void filled with floating menus.
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive red 'WARNING' sign flashes before Artie confirms his choice.

scenes.outcome: Artie arrives in the world of Aethelgard with a broken character sheet.
scenes.transition_in_text: The void collapses into a swirl of colors as Artie's feet hit solid ground.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie looks down at his hands, which are occasionally flickering out of existence.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard.

sections.title: The Tutorial Bug
sections.end_condition: The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit.

scenes.outcome: Artie enters the tutorial arena and meets the Golem.
scenes.transition_in_text: A stone gate rumbles open, inviting Artie into the tutorial combat zone.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Tutorial Golem rises from the center of the arena, its eyes glowing red.

scenes.outcome: Artie discovers that his attacks deal zero damage unless he hits a 'glitch point'.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Golem swings a massive stone fist, and Artie barely rolls out of the way.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie notices a flickering purple pixel on the Golem's left knee.

scenes.outcome: Artie strikes the glitch point, triggering a 1,000,000% damage multiplier.
scenes.transition_in_text: Lining up his rusty sword, Artie lunges for the flickering purple spot.
scenes.transition_out_text: The world freezes for a microsecond as the System calculates the impossible damage.

scenes.outcome: The Golem explodes into data fragments, ending the tutorial prematurely.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Golem doesn't just fall; it shatters into a million blue cubes that vanish into the air.
scenes.transition_out_text: A notification chime rings out, sounding more like a car alarm than a victory song.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit.

sections.title: Resource Management
sections.end_condition: Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.

scenes.outcome: Artie loots a 'Corrupted Core' from the Golem's remains.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie walks to the center of the arena where a single, pulsing object remains.
scenes.transition_out_text: The core hums in his hand, vibrating with an unstable energy.

scenes.outcome: The System warns Artie that his 'Stability' is at 15% and falling.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie leaves the arena behind, his character sheet flickering more frequently now.
scenes.transition_out_text: A scrolling text box informs him that total deletion is imminent without stabilization.

scenes.outcome: Artie learns he needs 'Stability Shards' found in the Whispering Woods.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie opens his quest log, which is mostly garbled code except for one clear objective.
scenes.transition_out_text: He looks toward the dark trees of the Whispering Woods, knowing his life depends on what's inside.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.

sections.title: The Grind is Real
sections.end_condition: Artie triggers a recursive loot loop in the Whispering Woods.

scenes.outcome: Artie enters the Whispering Woods and encounters low-level slimes.
scenes.transition_in_text: The air grows cold and damp as Artie steps under the canopy of the Whispering Woods.
scenes.transition_out_text: A group of green slimes bounces toward him, their movements rhythmic and predictable.

scenes.outcome: Artie tries to fight normally but finds his damage is too inconsistent.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie swings at the lead slime, his sword passing through it with a pathetic 'thwip' sound.
scenes.transition_out_text: He realizes he needs to find another glitch point to do any real damage.

scenes.outcome: Artie kills a slime on a 'loot-boundary' line, causing it to drop infinite items.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie backs up against a strange shimmering line in the air and strikes the slime just as it crosses it.
scenes.transition_out_text: Instead of one pile of loot, a fountain of items begins to erupt from the ground.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie triggers a recursive loot loop in the Whispering Woods.

sections.title: Looting the World Dry
sections.end_condition: The Whispering Woods dungeon is rendered completely empty of items and monsters.

scenes.outcome: The loot loop begins to lag the local area, freezing monsters in place.
scenes.transition_in_text: The pile of slime-gel and rusty daggers grows so large that the nearby trees start to flicker.
scenes.transition_out_text: A nearby wolf monster freezes mid-leap, suspended in the air by the processing load.

scenes.outcome: Artie walks through the frozen forest, 'harvesting' the stationary mobs.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie realizes he can just walk up to the frozen monsters and tap them for loot.
scenes.transition_out_text: He reaches the center of the woods, where the dungeon boss is stuck in a T-pose.

scenes.outcome: Artie loots the boss and every container in the zone, leaving it a void.
scenes.transition_in_text: With a single poke, the T-posing boss shatters, dropping the final shards Artie needs.
scenes.transition_out_text: The forest is now eerily empty, not a single blade of grass or pebble remaining.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The Whispering Woods dungeon is rendered completely empty of items and monsters.

sections.title: Market Crash
sections.end_condition: Artie observes the Adventurers' Guild arriving to investigate the 'looted' dungeon.

scenes.outcome: Artie returns to the nearby town and sells his mountain of trash loot.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie staggers into town, his inventory bags bulging with more items than should be physically possible.
scenes.transition_out_text: The local merchant's eyes widen as Artie dumps a thousand slime-gels onto the counter.

scenes.outcome: The Guild arrives to find the Whispering Woods 'deleted'.
scenes.transition_in_text: A group of high-level adventurers gallops past Artie, heading toward the forest with worried expressions.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie watches from the shadows as they realize their primary training ground is gone.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie observes the Adventurers' Guild arriving to investigate the 'looted' dungeon.

sections.title: The Stability Tax
sections.end_condition: Artie locates the 'Cooldown Reset' gem within the city's high-security vault.

scenes.outcome: Artie's stability drops to 5%, causing his UI to glitch violently.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie tries to check his gold balance, but the numbers turn into screaming skulls.
scenes.transition_out_text: He realizes he needs a massive power source to keep his character from deleting itself.

scenes.outcome: Artie bribes a local thief for information on the 'Cooldown Reset' gem.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie follows a hooded figure into a narrow alley where the sun doesn't reach.
scenes.transition_out_text: The thief points toward the massive stone citadel in the center of the city.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the vault's exterior and identifies the security wards.
scenes.transition_in_text: The citadel looms over Artie, its walls covered in glowing blue security runes.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie spots a flickering rune that looks exactly like the glitch point on the Golem.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie locates the 'Cooldown Reset' gem within the city's high-security vault.

sections.title: The Vault Heist
sections.end_condition: Artie successfully acquires the Cooldown Reset gem.

scenes.outcome: Artie 'clips' through the first security gate by exploiting a collision bug.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie walks straight into the corner of the gate, vibrating his character back and forth.
scenes.transition_out_text: With a sickening pop, he lands on the other side of the stone wall.

scenes.outcome: Artie bypasses the laser grid by turning his graphics settings to 'Low'.
scenes.transition_in_text: A grid of lethal red lasers blocks the path, but Artie opens his settings menu.
scenes.transition_out_text: The lasers disappear as his UI fails to render them, allowing him to walk right through.

scenes.outcome: Artie fights the Vault Guardian by baiting it into a bottomless pit glitch.
scenes.transition_in_text: A massive mechanical spider drops from the ceiling, its legs clicking against the gold coins.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie stands over a hole in the floor that leads to an infinite black void.

scenes.outcome: Artie grabs the gem just as the Guardian falls into the void.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Guardian lunges, misses, and vanishes into the black hole with a digital scream.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie reaches out and snatches the glowing green gem from its pedestal.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie successfully acquires the Cooldown Reset gem.

sections.title: Burn the Bridge
sections.end_condition: Artie escapes through the city gates with the guard in pursuit.

scenes.outcome: The vault alarms trigger, alerting the entire city guard.
scenes.transition_in_text: As soon as the gem leaves the pedestal, the walls begin to glow bright red.
scenes.transition_out_text: The sound of heavy boots echoes from the other side of the vault door.

scenes.outcome: Artie leads the guards on a chaotic chase through the city market.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie bursts out of the citadel, nearly knocking over a fruit cart as he sprints.
scenes.transition_out_text: He uses the 'Glitch-Crit' to jump over a building, leaving the guards staring in confusion.

scenes.outcome: Artie clears the city gates just as they slam shut.
scenes.transition_in_text: The city gates begin to descend, a massive wall of iron cutting off the exit.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie slides under the iron bars at the last second, rolling out into the open wilderness.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie escapes through the city gates with the guard in pursuit.

sections.title: Welcome to the Glitch
sections.end_condition: Artie enters the heart of a Dead Zone where the System is visibly broken.

scenes.outcome: Artie enters the Dead Zone to lose his pursuers.
scenes.transition_in_text: The city guards stop at the edge of the forest, refusing to follow Artie into the gray mist.
scenes.transition_out_text: The trees ahead are missing their textures, appearing as solid gray blocks.

scenes.outcome: Artie encounters visual bugs that make navigation difficult.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie steps forward, but his vision splits into three identical overlapping views.
scenes.transition_out_text: He has to close two eyes just to see the path correctly.

scenes.outcome: The pursuers are forced to turn back as the reality stability drops.
scenes.transition_in_text: Behind him, the guards' leader shouts a final warning before retreating.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie is now truly alone in the broken part of the world.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the center of the Dead Zone where gravity is inverted.
scenes.transition_in_text: The ground begins to slope upward, but Artie feels lighter with every step.
scenes.transition_out_text: He looks up to see a lake of water hovering in the sky.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie enters the heart of a Dead Zone where the System is visibly broken.

sections.title: Logic Errors
sections.end_condition: Artie survives a major reality-warping environmental hazard.

scenes.outcome: Artie is attacked by 'Corrupted Stalkers' that teleport randomly.
scenes.transition_in_text: A flicker of static appears to Artie's left, followed by a clawed hand.
scenes.transition_out_text: The monsters blink in and out of existence, making them impossible to track.

scenes.outcome: Artie falls into a 'texture-less' pit and must find his way out.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie takes a step onto what looks like solid ground, but his foot passes right through.
scenes.transition_out_text: He lands in a place where there is no light, no shadow, only flat white.

scenes.outcome: Artie fights a 'Null-Boss' that tries to delete his inventory.
scenes.transition_in_text: A giant eraser-like entity slides across the white floor toward Artie.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie watches as his sword turns semi-transparent, its data being wiped.

scenes.outcome: Artie uses the Cooldown Reset gem to 're-spawn' his deleted items.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie activates the gem, and a wave of green energy restores his gear.
scenes.transition_out_text: The white pit shatters like glass, returning Artie to the corrupted valley.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie survives a major reality-warping environmental hazard.

sections.title: Safe Mode
sections.end_condition: Artie finds and enters the hidden sanctuary.

scenes.outcome: Artie spots a door that shouldn't exist in the middle of a field.
scenes.transition_in_text: Amidst the floating rocks, a perfectly normal wooden door stands alone.
scenes.transition_out_text: The door has a sign on it that reads 'SAFE MODE - AUTHORIZED ONLY'.

scenes.outcome: Artie enters the door and finds a cozy library.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie turns the handle and steps into a room filled with the smell of old paper.
scenes.transition_out_text: The chaos of the Dead Zone is instantly silenced as the door clicks shut.

scenes.outcome: Artie meets the 'Archivist' and learns about his class origins.
scenes.transition_in_text: An elderly man in a digital-patterned robe looks up from a massive tome.
scenes.transition_out_text: The man explains that Artie's class is a leftover from the System's beta phase.

scenes.outcome: Artie is given a map to the 'Stability Patch' item.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Archivist hands Artie a parchment that glows with internal data.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie prepares to leave the sanctuary, knowing exactly where he must go.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie finds and enters the hidden sanctuary.

sections.title: The Anti-Glitched
sections.end_condition: The Bounty Hunter successfully corners Artie and disables his glitch abilities.

scenes.outcome: Artie is tracked by Silas the Nullifier.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie walks through the canyons, unaware of the silent figure following him from the ridges.
scenes.transition_out_text: A blue arrow suddenly appears above Artie's head, marking him as a target.

scenes.outcome: Silas activates a 'Nullification Zone' that stabilizes the area.
scenes.transition_in_text: Silas drops from the ridge, slamming a metallic rod into the ground.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie's flickering hands turn solid, and his glitch-crit multiplier vanishes.

scenes.outcome: Artie is pinned down and realizes he can't use his exploits.
scenes.transition_in_text: Silas points a crossbow at Artie's chest, his face completely hidden by a visor.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie tries to trigger a glitch, but the System returns a 'Feature Disabled' error.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The Bounty Hunter successfully corners Artie and disables his glitch abilities.

sections.title: Back to Basics
sections.end_condition: Artie defeats the Bounty Hunter using clever use of the environment.

scenes.outcome: Artie uses physical combat to survive the initial assault.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie kicks a cloud of dust into Silas's face and dives for cover.
scenes.transition_out_text: He realizes he has to fight like a normal player for the first time.

scenes.outcome: Artie notices a loose boulder above the Nullification rod.
scenes.transition_in_text: While dodging bolts, Artie's eyes scan the canyon walls for any advantage.
scenes.transition_out_text: The boulder is held up by a single, thin vine.

scenes.outcome: Artie destroys the Nullification rod by dropping the boulder on it.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie throws his sword at the vine, the blade slicing through it perfectly.
scenes.transition_out_text: The boulder crushes the rod, and the purple field shatters instantly.

scenes.outcome: Artie uses a single Glitch-Crit to finish Silas.
scenes.transition_in_text: With his powers restored, Artie hits Silas with a strike that deals infinite damage.
scenes.transition_out_text: Silas is knocked back into the canyon wall, his health bar hitting zero instantly.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie defeats the Bounty Hunter using clever use of the environment.

sections.title: The Scout's Warning
sections.end_condition: Artie realizes he is being hunted by a major guild.

scenes.outcome: Artie loots a communication device from Silas.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie searches the hunter's body and finds a small, humming crystal.
scenes.transition_out_text: A voice speaks from the crystal, asking for a status report on the 'Anomaly'.

scenes.outcome: Artie hears the Guild's plan to send a full raid team after him.
scenes.transition_in_text: The voice mentions the 'Iron Vanguard' and their arrival in the next hour.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie realizes Silas was just the scout, and the real fight is coming.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie realizes he is being hunted by a major guild.

sections.title: Storming the Lair
sections.end_condition: Artie reaches the inner sanctum of the regional boss.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the entrance of the Data-Wraith's lair.
scenes.transition_in_text: The obsidian tower looms ahead, surrounded by a swirling storm of digital snow.
scenes.transition_out_text: The front gates are guarded by two massive, low-poly dragons.

scenes.outcome: Artie fights the outer guard using his Cooldown Reset gem.
scenes.transition_in_text: The dragons roar, their voices sounding like grinding metal as they charge.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie spams his abilities, resetting the cooldowns every second to keep up the pressure.

scenes.outcome: Artie defeats the elite guardians and enters the tower.
scenes.transition_in_text: With a final blast of green energy, the dragons dissolve into pixels.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps inside the tower, the air growing thick with the smell of ozone.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the elevator leading to the final boss arena.
scenes.transition_in_text: A platform of light waits at the end of the hall, pulsing with a steady rhythm.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps onto the platform, and it begins to ascend rapidly.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie reaches the inner sanctum of the regional boss.

sections.title: The One-Percent Roll
sections.end_condition: The regional boss is defeated and the Stability Patch is dropped.

scenes.outcome: Artie meets the Data-Wraith and the fight begins.
scenes.transition_in_text: The elevator stops at the top of the tower, where a massive shadowy figure waits.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Data-Wraith raises its hand, and the floor begins to disintegrate.

scenes.outcome: Artie struggles against the Wraith's 'Phase-Shift' ability.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie swings his sword, but it passes through the Wraith like smoke.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Wraith counters with a blast of corruption that nearly knocks Artie off the edge.

scenes.outcome: The Wraith enters Phase 2, summoning dozens of glitch-mobs.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Wraith screams, and the air around it tears open, releasing smaller shadows.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie is surrounded, his health bar flashing red as he takes hit after hit.

scenes.outcome: Artie gambles on a 'Total System Crash' glitch to win.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie stops fighting and begins to open every menu, settings, and log file at once.
scenes.transition_out_text: The world begins to stutter, the Wraith's movements slowing to a crawl.

scenes.outcome: The Wraith is deleted by the lag, dropping the Stability Patch.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Wraith's model stretches and distorts until it simply pops out of existence.
scenes.transition_out_text: A golden disk falls to the ground, glowing with a stable, white light.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The regional boss is defeated and the Stability Patch is dropped.

sections.title: Critical Exposure
sections.end_condition: Artie's exact location is broadcast to the entire world.

scenes.outcome: Artie picks up the Stability Patch.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie reaches for the golden disk, his hands finally stopping their flickering.
scenes.transition_out_text: The moment he touches it, a massive pillar of light shoots into the sky.

scenes.outcome: A global announcement identifies Artie as the 'World Boss'.
scenes.transition_in_text: A booming voice echoes across the entire world, audible even to Artie.
scenes.transition_out_text: The voice declares that the anomaly has been located and a bounty has been set.

scenes.outcome: Artie sees his own coordinates appearing in the sky.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie looks up and sees massive red numbers floating in the clouds above him.
scenes.transition_out_text: He realizes he has no more places to hide.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie's exact location is broadcast to the entire world.

sections.title: Patching the Hole
sections.end_condition: The 'Stability Patch' is successfully integrated into Artie's character sheet.

scenes.outcome: Artie retreats to a nearby cave to use the patch.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie dives into a small cave as the first group of players arrives at the tower.
scenes.transition_out_text: He pulls out the golden disk, his heart racing.

scenes.outcome: The patch process begins, causing intense pain.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie presses the disk to his chest, and a searing heat spreads through his body.
scenes.transition_out_text: His character sheet flashes through thousands of lines of code per second.

scenes.outcome: Artie's stability hits 100%, and his class is permanently modified.
scenes.transition_in_text: The heat fades, leaving Artie feeling more 'real' than he ever has in this world.
scenes.transition_out_text: His class name changes from 'Glitch-Crit' to 'System-Breaker'.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The 'Stability Patch' is successfully integrated into Artie's character sheet.

sections.title: The Deletion Event
sections.end_condition: Artie narrowly escapes the collapsing zone.

scenes.outcome: The System begins a 'Zone Reset' to purge Artie.
scenes.transition_in_text: The walls of the cave begin to turn into white cubes and vanish.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie runs out of the cave to find the entire region dissolving around him.

scenes.outcome: Artie uses his new abilities to 'bridge' the gaps in reality.
scenes.transition_in_text: A massive chasm opens in front of him, but Artie 'manifests' a temporary platform.
scenes.transition_out_text: He leaps across the void, the platform vanishing just as his feet leave it.

scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the regional border just as the zone is deleted.
scenes.transition_in_text: The white void is inches from his heels as Artie sprints for the shimmering regional line.
scenes.transition_out_text: He dives through the barrier just as the world behind him turns into nothingness.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie narrowly escapes the collapsing zone.

sections.title: New Region, New Problems
sections.end_condition: Artie crosses the border into the next region as a global target.

scenes.outcome: Artie arrives in the 'High-Level Wastes' and sees his bounty is now 1,000,000 gold.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie rolls to a stop on a patch of black sand, the air smelling of sulfur.
scenes.transition_out_text: A new bounty poster appears in his UI, with his face and a massive reward.

scenes.outcome: Artie smiles and prepares for the next phase of his journey.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie checks his new stats and sees that he's no longer just a glitch; he's a feature.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie crosses the border into the next region as a global target.
